Your knight on e4 is perfectly placed to deliver a forcing check on g3, attacking the king. White must recapture with the h-pawn (hxg3)—it's the only legal move. The lesson: when you have an active piece near the opponent's king, look for forcing checks that simplify the position toward mate.
